headline: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) Is Down 7.7% After Major Oilseed Crush Expansion And New COO Hire – Has The Bull Case Changed?
summary: In late July 2026, Archer-Daniels-Midland announced a series of investments to expand North American oilseed crush capacity across four U.S. plants, aiming to unlock about 700,000 metric tons of additional annual capacity by 2028–2029 to serve growing renewable fuel and vegetable oil demand. Alongside this capacity push, ADM is enhancing its U.S. processing footprint and has created a new Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer role, hiring industry veteran and fifth-generation...
